brief:
Young Israelis are shifting toward right-wing politics, according to Al Jazeera English, bucking the global trend of youth gravitating leftward. The rightward lean among Israel's younger generation could significantly influence the country's political trajectory and Netanyahu's prospects for maintaining power.

The demographic shift reflects broader political divisions within Israeli society, with younger voters increasingly embracing right-wing ideologies at a time when youth movements in other democracies typically embrace progressive politics.
dek: The global trend may show young people leaning politically to the left, but in Israel… they’re leaning to the right.
title: Israeli youth drift rightward, potentially bolstering Netanyahu's future
